## Reading Files: CARDIA Y00
```{r importing-Y00, ECHO=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# >>>>> YEAR 00 <<<<<<

library(readr)

#Be sure to replace the file path with the appropriate file path on your own computer. 

base_dir <- "/Volumes/Data/Coronary Artery Risk Development in Young Adults (CARDIA)/Main_Study/Y00/DATA/csv"

file_paths <- c(
  file.path(base_dir, "aaf01.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "aaf08v2.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "aaf09med.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "aaf09gen.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "aachem.csv")
)

for (i in seq_along(file_paths)) {
  oname <- paste0("df", i)
  assign(oname, read_csv(file_paths[i]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

## Cleaning: CARDIA Y00
```{r merging-V1, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#merging the data set
data_cardia_00 <- merge(df1, df2,  by ="RID", all = T) 
data_cardia_00 <- merge(data_cardia_00, df3,  by ="RID", all = T)
data_cardia_00 <- merge(data_cardia_00, df4,  by ="RID", all = T)
data_cardia_00 <- merge(data_cardia_00, df5,  by ="RID", all = T)

# cleaning
rm(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5,
   df6, file_paths, i, oname)

# Cleaning data
attach(data_cardia_00)

#creating new data frame which only has the variables of interest
df_cardia_00 <- data.frame(
  id_study = 'CARDIA_Y00',
  id       = as.character(RID),
  
  psu1     = NA,       
  psu2     = NA,
  
  stratum1 = NA,
  stratum2 = NA,

  psu_weight1 = NA,
  psu_weight2 = NA,
  psu_weight3 = NA,
  
  # demographics
  sex     = A01SEX, 
  age     = as.numeric(A01AGE2),
  race    = A01RACE2,
  edu_adult = NA, #level of education
  edu_years = as.numeric(A01ED2), #Years of education
  edu_child = NA,
  ethnicity = NA,
  
  #diabetes
  self_db      = A08DIAB, #diabetes ever
  age_told_db  = A09DIBAG,
  drug_insu_db = NA, #the question asked for for all types of med to control glucose, not "insulin" or oral meds, if needed A09MDCD1/2/3/4 == 47 should be those who had tx for dm (overall, not only insulin)
  drug_pill_db = NA, #the question asked for for all types of med to control glucose, not "insulin" or oral meds, if needed A09MDCD1/2/3/4 == 47 should be those who had tx for dm (overall, not only pills)
  family_hx_db = NA,
  
  #labs
  fasting_minutes = NA,
  fasting_hours   = NA,
  fasting_8h      = NA,
  fasting_12h     = NA,
  fglu         = as.numeric(AL3_GLU), units_fglu  = 'mg/dL',
  hba1c        = NA, units_hba1c = 'NA',
  pogtt          = NA, units_pogtt   = 'NA',
  insulin      = NA, units_insulin = 'NA',
  
  creatinine_urine = NA, creatinine_urine_units = 'NA',
  
  total_cholesterol        = NA, units_cholesterol = 'mg/dL',
  ldl                      = NA, units_ldl = 'mg/dL',
  
  #tb
  tb_history = NA,
  age_told_tb  = NA,
  tb_treatment = NA,
  tb_skin_test = NA, #self-reported
  tb_skin_test_result = NA, #self-reported - ONLY FOR POSITIVE SKIN TEST
  tb_medication_use = NA,
  
  # Measurements
  weight                   = NA, units_weight = 'kg',
  height                   = NA, units_height = 'cm',
  bmi                      = NA, units_bmi = 'KG/M**2',
  waist                    = NA, units_waist = 'cm',            #mean of 2 measures
  hip                      = NA, units_hip = 'cm',            #mean of 2 measures
  blood_pressure_sys       = NA, units_sbp = 'mmHg',
  blood_pressure_diast     = NA, units_dbp = 'mmHg'
)

# Extract baseline demographics from Y00
baseline_demo <- df_cardia_00 %>%
  select(
    id,
    sex,
    age,
    race
  ) 


# Eliminating duplicates
df_cardia_00 <- df_cardia_00 %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)


detach(data_cardia_00)



```

# Re-coding Y00, Y10, Y15, Y20 datasets

```{r cardia recode, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}

recode_cardia <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(

      # sex
      sex = case_when(
        sex == 1 ~ 1, #men
        sex == 2 ~ 2, #women
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # yes/no variables
      across(
        c(self_db, drug_insu_db, drug_pill_db,
          tb_history, tb_treatment, tb_medication_use,
          tb_skin_test, tb_skin_test_result, fasting_8h),
        ~ case_when(
          . == 2 ~ 1,
          . == 1 ~ 0,
          . == 8 ~ 9,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      ),
      
      # sex
      fasting_12h = case_when(
        fasting_12h == "NO"  ~ 0, 
        fasting_12h == "YES" ~ 1, 
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # race
      race = case_when(
        race == 4 ~ 0,                # black
        race == 5 ~ 1,                # white
        race == 3 ~ 2,                # hispanic
        race %in% c(6, 7) ~ 3,        # other/multiracial
        race == 8 ~ 9,                # DK
        TRUE ~ NA_real_               # missing
      ),

      # education
      edu_adult = case_when(
        edu_adult == 1 ~ 2,           # high school
        edu_adult %in% c(2, 3) ~ 3,   # some college
        edu_adult == 4 ~ 4,           # graduate studies
        edu_adult == 9 ~ 9,           # refused / DK / other (other included in CARDIA)
        TRUE ~ 9               # missing
      )

    )
}

# Re coding all dataset (Y00, Y10, Y15, and Y20)
df_cardia_00 <- recode_cardia(df_cardia_00)
df_cardia_10 <- recode_cardia(df_cardia_10)
df_cardia_15 <- recode_cardia(df_cardia_15)
df_cardia_20 <- recode_cardia(df_cardia_20)

```

# Cleaning numeric variables

```{r numeric-variables, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Summary of numeric variables - Y10
summary(df_cardia_10$weight)
summary(df_cardia_10$height)
summary(df_cardia_10$bmi)
summary(df_cardia_10$waist)
summary(df_cardia_10$hip)
summary(df_cardia_10$ldl)
summary(df_cardia_10$total_cholesterol)

# weight : lbs -> kg
df_cardia_10 <- df_cardia_10 %>%
  mutate(weight = weight * 0.453592)


library(dplyr)

df_cardia_10 <- df_cardia_10 %>%
  mutate(
    weight = ifelse(weight >= 12 & weight <= 300, weight, NA),        # Plausible range: 12-300 kg => 26.45 - 661.39 lbs
    height = ifelse(height >= 100 & height <= 250, height, NA),             # Plausible range: 100 - 250 cm
    bmi = ifelse(bmi >= 10 & bmi <= 80, bmi, NA),                           # Plausible range: 10-80 kg/m2
    waist = ifelse(waist >= 30 & waist <= 300, waist, NA),                  # Plausible range: 30 - 300 cm
    hip = ifelse(hip >= 40 & hip <= 300, hip, NA),                          # Plausible range: 40 - 300 cm
    ldl = ifelse(ldl >= 19.33 & ldl <= 386.65, ldl, NA),                    # Plausible range: 0.5 - 10 mmol/L => 19.33 - 386.65 mg/dl 
    total_cholesterol = ifelse(
      total_cholesterol >= 1.75 & total_cholesterol <= 20,                  # Plausible range: 1.75 - 20 mmol/L => 67.66 - 773.31 mg/dl  
      total_cholesterol, NA
    )
  )

# Summary of numeric variables - Y15
summary(df_cardia_15$weight)
summary(df_cardia_15$height)
summary(df_cardia_15$bmi)
summary(df_cardia_15$waist)

# weight : lbs -> kg
df_cardia_15 <- df_cardia_15 %>%
  mutate(weight = weight * 0.453592)

df_cardia_15 <- df_cardia_15 %>%
  mutate(
    weight = ifelse(weight >= 12 & weight <= 300, weight, NA),        # Plausible range: 12-300 kg => 26.45 - 661.39 lbs
    height = ifelse(height >= 100 & height <= 250, height, NA),             # Plausible range: 100 - 250 cm
    bmi = ifelse(bmi >= 10 & bmi <= 80, bmi, NA),                           # Plausible range: 10-80 kg/m2
    waist = ifelse(waist >= 30 & waist <= 300, waist, NA),                  # Plausible range: 30 - 300 cm
    hip = ifelse(hip >= 40 & hip <= 300, hip, NA),                          # Plausible range: 40 - 300 cm
    ldl = ifelse(ldl >= 19.33 & ldl <= 386.65, ldl, NA),                    # Plausible range: 0.5 - 10 mmol/L => 19.33 - 386.65 mg/dl 
    total_cholesterol = ifelse(
      total_cholesterol >= 1.75 & total_cholesterol <= 20,                  # Plausible range: 1.75 - 20 mmol/L => 67.66 - 773.31 mg/dl  
      total_cholesterol, NA
    )
  )
```

# Diabetes definitions

```{r data transf, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Transforming minutes to hours -> 8h cut off
df_cardia_15 <- df_cardia_15 %>%
  mutate(
    fasting_8h = case_when(
      !is.na(fasting_minutes) & fasting_minutes >= 480 ~ 1,   #  8 hours (480 min)
      !is.na(fasting_minutes) & fasting_minutes < 480 ~ 0,    # < 8 hours
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

df_cardia_20 <- df_cardia_20 %>%
  mutate(
    fasting_8h = case_when(
      !is.na(fasting_minutes) & fasting_minutes >= 480 ~ 1,   #  8 hours (480 min)
      !is.na(fasting_minutes) & fasting_minutes < 480 ~ 0,    # < 8 hours
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Cleaning fasting glucose: 
df_cardia_10 <- df_cardia_10 %>%
  mutate(
    fglu = case_when(
      fasting_8h == 0 ~ NA_real_,     # NA increased: 1189 -> 1268
      TRUE ~ fglu
    )
  )


df_cardia_15 <- df_cardia_15 %>%
  mutate(
    fglu = case_when(
      fasting_12h == 0 ~ NA_real_,    # NA increased: 1409 -> 1672
      TRUE ~ fglu
    )
  )


df_cardia_20 <- df_cardia_20 %>%
  mutate(
    fglu = case_when(
      fasting_12h == 0 ~ NA_real_,     # NA increased: 58 -> 280
      TRUE ~ fglu
    )
  )


# Diabetes: Self reported / labs (fasting glucose, HbA1c, oral glucose tolerance test)
create_self_lab_dm <- function(dm) {
  dm %>%
    mutate(
      self_lab_dm = case_when(
        self_db == 1 | fglu >= 126 | hba1c >= 6.5 | pogtt >= 200 ~ 1,
        !is.na(self_db) | !is.na(fglu) | !is.na(hba1c) | !is.na(pogtt) ~ 0,
        is.na(self_db) & is.na(fglu) & is.na(hba1c) & is.na(pogtt) ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}

df_cardia_00 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_cardia_00)
df_cardia_10 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_cardia_10)
df_cardia_15 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_cardia_15)
df_cardia_20 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_cardia_20)
```

# Labeling both datasets

```{r labeling, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
label_cardia <- function(label) {
  label %>%
    mutate(
      # Sex
      sex = factor(sex,
                   levels = c(1, 2),
                   labels = c("Men", "Women")),

      # TB variables
      tb_history = factor(tb_history,
                          levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                          labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_treatment = factor(tb_treatment,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_skin_test = factor(tb_skin_test,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_skin_test_result = factor(tb_skin_test_result,
                                   levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                                   labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_medication_use = factor(tb_medication_use,
                                 levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                                 labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),

      # Diabetes self-report + labs
      self_db = factor(self_db,
                       levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                       labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      drug_insu_db = factor(drug_insu_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      drug_pill_db = factor(drug_pill_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      self_lab_dm = factor(self_lab_dm,
                           levels = c(1, 0),
                           labels = c("Diabetes", "No Diabetes")),

      # Family history
      family_hx_db = factor(family_hx_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No")),

      # Race/Ethnicity
      race = factor(race,
                    levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 9),
                    labels = c("Non-Hispanic Black", 
                               "Non-Hispanic White", 
                               "Mexican/Other Hispanic", 
                               "Other/Multiracial", 
                               "Missing")),
      ethnicity = factor(ethnicity,
                         levels = c(1, 2, 9),
                         labels = c("Non-Hispanic", "Hispanic", "Missing")),

      # Education
      edu_adult = factor(edu_adult,
                         levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 9),
                         labels = c("< High School", 
                                    "High School Grad", 
                                    "Some College/AA", 
                                    "College+", 
                                    "Refused/DK"))
    )
}

df_cardia_00 <- label_cardia(df_cardia_00)
df_cardia_10 <- label_cardia(df_cardia_10)
df_cardia_15 <- label_cardia(df_cardia_15)
df_cardia_20 <- label_cardia(df_cardia_20)

```

```{r, CARDIA TABLE (Y10), message=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
library(gtsummary)

# Select the variables you want to include
vars_to_summarize <- c(
  "age", "sex", "race", "edu_adult", "self_db", "age_told_db", "drug_insu_db", "drug_pill_db",
  "self_lab_dm", "family_hx_db",
  "tb_history", "age_told_tb", "tb_treatment", "fasting_minutes", "fglu", "hba1c", "total_cholesterol", "ldl", "weight", "height", "bmi",  "waist", "hip", "blood_pressure_sys", "blood_pressure_diast", "tb_dm")

# Create table1
CARDIA_Y10_table <- df_cardia_10 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_summarize), tb_dm) %>%  # include the grouping variable
  tbl_summary(
    by = tb_dm,  # group by TB+DM
    type = list(
      age ~ "continuous",
      age_told_db ~ "continuous",
      age_told_tb ~ "continuous",
      fglu ~ "continuous",
      hba1c ~ "continuous",
      fasting_minutes ~ "continuous",
      total_cholesterol ~ "continuous",
      ldl ~ "continuous",
      weight ~ "continuous",
      height ~ "continuous",
      bmi ~ "continuous",
      waist ~ "continuous",
      hip ~ "continuous",
      blood_pressure_sys ~ "continuous",
      blood_pressure_diast ~ "continuous"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
    ),
    label = var_label(df_cardia_10),
    missing = "no"
  ) 

CARDIA_Y10_table <- CARDIA_Y10_table %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variables**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c(stat_1, stat_2) ~ "**Summary Statistics (CARDIA Y10)**")

CARDIA_Y10_table
```
